review.notes: Full review of a repaired head. The four findings of the previous review (R01-R04) are repaired. Adversarial pass over every statement of Layers 0-4 with computed values (22 table rows); 27 library declarations opened at the pins; supplier citations resolved in InfinitaryModelExistence (main and open revision), RandomGraphs, SequentCalculusAndCutElimination and LogicAndDefinabilityInNumberTheory at their heads. Seeded sample: only the Robinson-Zakon locators of 3.3 could be read (3 checked, supported); Tent-Ziegler, Marker and Chang-Keisler are not legally readable and are listed as not verifiable. Dependency check: 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning; one-tactic probe closes none of the 20 theorems. Automatic checks: the five undeclared-name hits set aside as false positives (one Tau Ceti declaration, four names the README says belong to the Mathlib series). Two small corrections (variable types of the coded sequents in 4.2; Robinson-Zakon's definition is by primes) and four format notes.
